PSALM CXIX. VER. 172.
My tongue shall speak of thy Word, for all thy Commandments are Righteousness.
THE Man of God had spoken in the former Verse, how his lips should praise God; here is his second Promise that he maketh, of holy Conference with others.
First, Davids Resolution; My tongue shall speak of thy Word.
Secondly, The Reason; because it contained matter that deserved to be spoken off: For all thy Commandments are righteousness.

1. He speaketh of the whole Word of God, all thy commandments.
2. In the Abstract, are righteousness; altogether Righteous and Faithful.
